newsitem.title: CHINA: China sets standards for share issue prospectuses.
newsitem.headline: China sets standards for share issue prospectuses.

text.p: China has formulated a complete set of standards for share issue prospectuses to replace the uncoordinated rules currently in use, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday.
The newspaper said the standardised regulations, which would come into effect on April 1, required firms issuing shares to disclose details of all companies with which they are related.
The rules, issued by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the top securities watchdog, also ordered the firms to give a full assessment of the business risks they faced, the newspaper said.
